name: penup
description: Penup: A dynamic content pipeline orchestrator and CLI that transforms variable-driven path patterns into structured, automated content workflows
author: KazViz <kaz@kazviz.com> (https://kazviz.com)

scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:min && bun run build:cli && bun run build:type
scripts.build:main: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target bun
scripts.build:min: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming [name].min.[ext] --format esm --target bun --minify
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming cli.js --format esm --target bun
scripts.build:type: bun x dts-bundle-generator --no-check --project tsconfig.json -o dist/index.d.ts src/index.ts
scripts.ci: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check && bun run test
